name: Stipend Scheme For Poultry Farming Training For Weaker Section
benefit:
1. The beneficiary will be given maximum ₹2000 (direct in bank account) stipend for six days training. (Considering ₹300/- per day, ₹1800/- for 6 days as daily allowance and ₹200/- as to &amp; fro transport fare with the maximum total stipend ₹2000/-)
   1. Beneficiary will be given poultry training certificate after completion of training.
_eligibility_text:
1. The benefits of this scheme will only be given to the adult of economically weaker sections people of the society of Gujarat State.
   1. The beneficiary will have to provide income proof along with the application.
   1. Females and beneficiaries Below Poverty Line will be given priority.
